The '''I2AM''',<ref name="ISB" /> also known as the '''I2-AM3'''<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]/[[Astrogation/Legends|astrogator]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] carried aboard the [[Tech 4 PDV]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> They were based on the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="CSWE" />
